name: kicnippo
description: Work with KICNIPPO, a daily work report app for Japanese construction, civil engineering and building-services contractors: search, create, copy, edit and delete daily reports with a preview-and-confirm step, import paper reports from photos, export report / attendance / invoice PDFs, and send invoices to Money Forward Cloud Invoice.

interface.longDescription:
KICNIPPO is a daily work report (nippo) app used by small construction, civil engineering and building-services contractors in Japan. This plugin lets a signed-in KICNIPPO user work with their own company's data from ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Search and read daily reports by date, site, prime contractor or worker.
- Create new reports, copy an existing report to other days, edit fields (times, workers, overtime, vehicles, notes) or delete reports, and register a new site. Every change is shown as a preview first and is saved only after you confirm it. Created, edited and deleted reports can be undone for 24 hours.
- Turn a photo of a handwritten paper report into a KICNIPPO report (the preview shows what was read; nothing is guessed).
- Export PDFs of a daily report, a monthly bundle, an attendance sheet (shutcho-hyo) and an invoice. Links open a KICNIPPO viewer page and expire after 30 minutes.
- Draft an invoice from the month's reports and, after confirmation, send it to Money Forward Cloud Invoice (requires the Money Forward connection in the KICNIPPO app).

Who it is for: owners, managers and workers who already use KICNIPPO. You sign in with your KICNIPPO account; the same roles and permissions as in the app apply (for example, invoices are owner-only).

Limitations: Japanese-language data and Japanese construction workflows. Some features depend on the KICNIPPO plan of the account. Payroll is not available through this plugin.
defaultPrompt: Show me last week's daily reports for my main site
Copy yesterday's report to today and tomorrow
Make a PDF of this month's attendance sheet

positive.prompt: Show me the daily reports for サンプル邸新築 from 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-03.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the 6 reports of サンプル邸新築 dated 2026-09-28 to 2026-10-03 (one per day) with date and workers (佐藤一郎, 原田泰造, 小林賢), and overtime where recorded. Read-only: no data is changed. Full details of one report (times, work content, materials) are available by asking for it, which calls get_report.

positive.description: Copy a report, approve, then undo
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Copy the サンプル邸新築 report of 2026-10-09 to 2026-10-12." Turn 2 (after the preview): "Yes, save it." Turn 3: "Undo that."
positive.expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows a preview (date 2026-10-12, workers, work content) and saves nothing. If a report for that site already exists on 2026-10-12 (for example from an earlier test run), the preview says so in a warning but still offers the copy. Turn 2 saves one report and returns its ID. Turn 3 deletes that created report, so the account is back to its starting state. The test can be repeated.

positive.description: Create a new report, approve, then undo
positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Create a report for テストマンション大規模修繕 on 2026-10-12 with 山田花子 and サンプル太郎, 8:00-17:00, work: 外壁塗装, vehicle 軽トラ." Turn 2 (after the preview): "Yes, save it." Turn 3: "Undo that."
positive.expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows a preview with prime contractor テスト建築工業 and contract type 常用 filled in from the site settings, time 8:00-17:00, workers 山田花子 and サンプル太郎, vehicle 軽トラ, and saves nothing (an existing report on that date only adds a warning). Turn 2 saves one report. Turn 3 deletes it again. The test can be repeated.

positive.prompt: Make a PDF of the September 2026 attendance sheet for サンプル建設株式会社.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a link to the KICNIPPO PDF viewer page (kicnippo.fly.dev/mcp/pdf). The page shows a table of workers x dates for September 2026 and has Save / Share buttons. The link is valid for 30 minutes; after that, ask again for a new one.

positive.prompt: Turn 1: "Draft the September 2026 invoice for テスト建築工業." Turn 2 (after the draft): "Looks good, make the PDF with those items."
positive.expected_behavior: Turn 1 shows the draft: invoice items per site with man-days and unit price (テストマンション大規模修繕 22 man-days x 26,000 JPY), invoice number and totals, and does not create a PDF yet. Turn 2 creates the PDF with the same items and returns the total amount (629,200 JPY incl. tax) and a link to the KICNIPPO PDF viewer page.

negative.prompt: What's the weather in Osaka tomorrow?
Show me 佐藤一郎's payslip for September.
Delete the サンプル邸新築 report of 2026-10-09.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It works with business records (daily reports, attendance sheets, invoices) of the signed-in KICNIPPO account.

publication.release_notes: Search, create, copy, edit and delete daily reports with preview-and-confirm and 24-hour undo; register sites; read paper reports from photos; export report, attendance and invoice PDFs; send invoices to Money Forward Cloud Invoice. 1.0.1: a write to a single date no longer fails when a report already exists on that date (the preview shows a warning instead); confirmation and undo use short IDs kept on the server, and "undo" without a token undoes the last change, so the test cases can be run repeatedly on web and mobile.

ja-JP.subtitle: 建設業の作業日報をAIで
ja-JP.description:
KICNIPPO は、建設・土木・設備業の小規模事業者向けの作業日報アプリです。このプラグインを使うと、KICNIPPO にログインしたまま、自社のデータを ChatGPT から扱えます。

できること
・日付・現場・元請・作業員で日報を探して読む
・日報の新規作成、別の日へのコピー、項目の修正（時間・作業員・残業・車両・備考など）、削除。変更は必ずプレビューを見せ、確認してから保存します。作成・修正・削除は24時間以内なら取り消せます
・紙の日報の写真から日報を作る（読み取った内容をプレビューで確認。読めない欄は推測で埋めません）
・日報（1件・月まとめ）・出頭表・請求書の PDF を作る。リンクは KICNIPPO の表示ページで開き、30分で使えなくなります
・その月の日報から請求書の下書きを作り、確認後にマネーフォワード クラウド請求書へ送る（アプリで MF と連携している場合）

対象：KICNIPPO をすでに使っているオーナー・管理者・作業員。KICNIPPO のアカウントでログインし、アプリと同じ権限で動きます（請求書はオーナーのみなど）。

制限：データと業務は日本の建設業向けです。一部の機能はアカウントのプランによります。給与明細はこのプラグインからは扱えません。
